title: Zéro French
tagline: A free, project-based curriculum that takes you from zero French to passing the TCF Canada.

paths.title: A1 Basics
paths.description: Start from zero: learn the French alphabet, pronunciation, greetings, basic grammar and everyday vocabulary.

sections.title: Greetings & Introductions
sections.description: Say hello, introduce yourself, and understand basic polite phrases in French.

lessons.title: Greetings and Politeness
lessons.description: Learn to greet people formally and informally, say goodbye, and use basic polite expressions.

lessons.title: Personal Identity and Essential Verbs
lessons.description: State your name, nationality, age, and profession using the essential verbs être and avoir.

lessons.title: Family and Relationships
lessons.description: Describe immediate family members, marital status, and express relationships using possessive adjectives.

lessons.title: Everyday Objects and Grammatical Gender
lessons.description: Name common home and workplace objects, master definite and indefinite articles (le, la, un, une), and describe items with basic colors.

lessons.title: Project: Introduce Yourself
lessons.description: Record a short self-introduction in French using the greetings and polite phrases you have learned.

sections.title: Daily Routine & Places
sections.description: Conjugate regular verbs, talk about your daily schedule, and navigate buildings and town landmarks.

lessons.title: Regular -er Verbs and Daily Actions
lessons.description: Conjugate present tense regular -er verbs for routine morning and evening activities, work, and leisure.
